'''Null Assembly''' is a monthly online reading group announced on 14 March 2020.<ref name="announcement">[https://fixtures.invalid/null-assembly/announcement Null Assembly announcement], Null Assembly, 14 March 2020.</ref> Its earliest preserved public session page is dated 9 May 2020; the available archive does not establish when the group first met.<ref name="archive">[https://fixtures.invalid/null-assembly/archive Null Assembly public session archive], Null Assembly, updated 2 December 2023.</ref>

The absence of preserved March and April session pages does not show that no sessions took place in those months.<ref name="announcement"/><ref name="archive"/>
